notesZh: 新增多療程重疊時段的同時服用與延後 1 小時選擇。
同時提醒的多種藥物會在同一視窗分別確認，全部勾選後才會關閉。
延後療程會以實際時間發出提醒，日程與小喵手皆會顯示正確時間。
notesEn: Added a choice to take overlapping medication courses together or delay the new course by one hour.
Concurrent medications stay in one confirmation dialog until every course is checked.
Delayed courses send at their actual time and display the correct time in the schedule and assistant.
